Measures API Reference

This page documents network-level measures, path functions, and census functions available in SNA.jl.

Network-Level Measures

Density and Reciprocity

SNA.density — Function
density(net) -> Float64

Compute network density (proportion of possible edges that exist). Alias for network_density from Network.jl.

source
SNA.gden — Function
gden(net) -> Float64

Alias for density (R sna compatibility).

source
SNA.reciprocity — Function
reciprocity(net; method=:dyadic) -> Float64

Compute network reciprocity (proportion of mutual ties).

Arguments

  • net: Network object (should be directed)
  • method::Symbol=:dyadic: Reciprocity measure type
    • :dyadic: Proportion of dyads that are mutual
    • :edgewise: Proportion of edges that are reciprocated
source
SNA.grecip — Function
grecip(net; kwargs...) -> Float64

Alias for reciprocity (R sna compatibility).

source
SNA.mutuality — Function
mutuality(net) -> Float64

Compute network mutuality (proportion of pairs with symmetric relationships).

source

Transitivity and Hierarchy

SNA.transitivity — Function
transitivity(net; type=:global) -> Float64

Compute network transitivity (clustering coefficient).

Arguments

  • net: Network object
  • type::Symbol=:global: Type of transitivity
    • :global: Global clustering coefficient
    • :local: Vector of local clustering coefficients
    • :average: Average of local clustering coefficients
source
SNA.gtrans — Function
gtrans(net; kwargs...) -> Float64

Alias for transitivity (R sna compatibility).

source
SNA.hierarchy — Function
hierarchy(net) -> Float64

Compute Krackhardt's hierarchy measure.

Measures the proportion of pairs with a strictly hierarchical relationship (one can reach the other but not vice versa).

source
SNA.efficiency — Function
efficiency(net) -> Float64

Compute network efficiency (1 minus the proportion of edges in excess of a tree).

source
SNA.connectedness — Function
connectedness(net) -> Float64

Compute network connectedness (proportion of pairs where at least one can reach the other).

source

Census Functions

Functions for classifying dyads, triads, and components.

SNA.dyad_census — Function
dyad_census(net) -> NamedTuple

Compute the dyad census (mutual, asymmetric, null counts).

Returns

NamedTuple with fields:

  • mutual::Int: Number of mutual dyads
  • asymmetric::Int: Number of asymmetric dyads
  • null::Int: Number of null dyads
source
SNA.triad_census — Function
triad_census(net) -> Vector{Int}

Compute the triad census (16-element vector for directed networks).

Returns counts of each of the 16 isomorphism classes of triads: 003, 012, 102, 021D, 021U, 021C, 111D, 111U, 030T, 030C, 201, 120D, 120U, 120C, 210, 300

source
SNA.component_dist — Function
component_dist(net) -> Vector{Int}

Return the distribution of component sizes.

source

Path Functions

Functions for computing distances, reachability, and path-based summaries.

SNA.geodesic_distance — Function
geodesic_distance(net) -> Matrix{Float64}

Compute the matrix of geodesic (shortest path) distances.

Returns Inf for unreachable pairs.

source
SNA.reachability — Function
reachability(net) -> Matrix{Bool}

Compute the reachability matrix.

Entry (i,j) is true if vertex i can reach vertex j via some path.

source
SNA.diameter — Function
diameter(net) -> Float64

Compute the diameter of the network (longest shortest path).

Returns Inf if the network is disconnected.

source
SNA.average_path_length — Function
average_path_length(net) -> Float64

Compute the average shortest path length over all reachable pairs.

source
